params.script_inline:
import sys, json
# The import lane. A colony that is supposed to remember months has to be
# given months, and the way in is NOT the conversation surface: a replayed
# turn already has an event time, and re-speaking it through the agent would
# stamp it with today.
#
# So this cell speaks the memory's episode port DIRECTLY -- the same port the
# drain speaks after every live turn. One port, two producers: the drain knows
# what was just said, this lane knows what was said in January. Neither of
# them is a special case of the other, and the memory behind the port cannot
# tell them apart, which is exactly the property that makes a port a port.
#
# The event time rides in `context`, never on the turn: a UBF turn carries
# origin, type, text and id and NOTHING else, so a timestamp glued to it would
# be refused at the delivery boundary. The header is where per-message facts
# about a message belong.
doc = json.load(sys.stdin)
d = doc["body"]
envelope = doc["envelope"]
header = envelope.get("header") or {}
context = header.get("context") or {}
turn = None
for m in d.get("messages") or []:
    if m.get("type") in ("text", None) and m.get("origin") in ("user", "assistant"):
        turn = m
        break
if turn is None:
    sys.stdout.write("[]")
    sys.exit(0)
session = str(context.get("session_id") or "import")
sys.stdout.write(json.dumps([{
    "header": {"route": "episode", "session_id": session,
               "turn_id": str(context.get("turn_id") or ""),
               "happened_at": str(context.get("happened_at") or "")},
    "messages": [turn]}]))

description.purpose: The import lane of this colony: it puts one past turn on the memory's episode port under the instant it was said, taken from the request headers rather than from a clock.
description.use_when: Once per colony that has a past to load: a migration off another agent, an archive, a month of exported chat.
description.not_in_scope: No screening, no session, no memory of its own, no answer, no batching. It decides nothing about content and reads no clock -- an imported turn keeps the time it happened.
